x: Policeman Rob Harding turned up in spite of being "on nights" and Jerome Curtat, now living in Paris but on a flying visit to London to see his brother, had thoughtfully brought his kit with him.
Rob Harding was our sole representative in the Kent County Championship at Sevenoaks on the same day. The race was won in 38:52 by Alan Graffin of Tonbridge with Rob in 55th with 48:20. 139 finished.

Clonliffe's Noel Cullen burst ahead on the second circuit but Jason, whose job was to bring us home in the top half dozen, was settled into the chasing bunch and far from a simple top six place, handed over to Rob McHarg in 2nd with a time that stood up as our fastest until the final stage.
